summary: Growth and belief flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use optimism and compassion with awareness.
body: Growth and belief flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use optimism and compassion with awareness. Imaginative ideas that turn out to have practical application. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through growth and belief, imagination and longing, and the choices you make when overreach or confusion starts running the room.
gift: The gift is optimism, compassion, and a more conscious way to work with growth and belief and imagination and longing.
shadow: The shadow is overreach, confusion, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let growth and belief and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
do: Name how growth and belief and imagination and longing are both involved
Turn optimism and compassion into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of growth and belief or imagination and longing
